svg.title: ONB-S06 - Supported platform change
svg.desc: Enabled transitions only; Private A to Private B remains disabled. Solid arrows are requests; dashed arrows are paired responses. Grey bars show handling intervals, not duration. Requests: solid / filled arrow. Responses: dashed / open arrow. Grey bars: handling intervals; timing is not to scale. Precondition: authorised business/dataset access and correct environment. Spain builds and logical contracts remain to be qualified. HTTP success is not readiness or activation. Failed / uncertain evidence returns an owned hold; observe original effects under ONB-08.
svg.text: Enabled transitions only; Private A to Private B remains disabled
Existing = documented API / guide; To qualify = logical handoff, no confirmed Spain contract.

Continue dependent checks only after valid NIF, current action authority and required certificate readiness
ONB-02/03/08 | Unconfirmed evidence holds only dependent work
Require a supported, enabled transition and continuity evidence. Private A to Private B stays disabled.
ONB-07/09 | Unsupported or unconfirmed transition returns an owned hold
Requests: solid / filled arrow. Responses: dashed / open arrow. Grey bars: handling intervals; timing is not to scale.
Precondition: authorised business/dataset access and correct environment. Spain builds and logical contracts remain to be qualified.
HTTP success is not readiness or activation. Failed / uncertain evidence returns an owned hold; observe original effects under ONB-08.
